Private wb As Object

Public Sub Setup()
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
End Sub

Public Sub Reopen(ByVal folder As String)
    Dim path As String
    path = folder & Application.PathSeparator & "audit.xlsx"
    wb.SaveAs path, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(path)
End Sub

Public Sub Finish()
    wb.Close False
End Sub

Private Function Show(v As Variant) As String
    If IsNull(v) Then
        Show = "Null"
    ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
        Show = "Empty"
    ElseIf Len(CStr(v)) > 40 Then
        Show = TypeName(v) & " " & Len(CStr(v))
    Else
        Show = TypeName(v) & " " & CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Private Function StateValidation(ws As Object) As String
    Dim s As String, v As Variant, o As Object
    On Error Resume Next
    Set o = ws.Range("B2").Validation
    v = Empty

    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        s = s & "|e" & Err.Number
        Err.Clear
    Else
        s = s & "|" & Show(v)
    End If
    v = Empty
    v = o.ErrorMessage
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        s = s & "|e" & Err.Number
        Err.Clear

        s = s & "|" & Show(v)
